title: Raglan Cross Graphic Tee & Cargo
prompt: An original young woman with dark hair in a messy updo wears a black and white raglan long-sleeve tee with a large gothic cross graphic and chain-link detail. A black leather belt with a silver buckle cinches black cargo trousers. Her expression is calm and direct. A pale backdrop with white cars at the sides. Palette of black, white, and gunmetal. Edgy and bold, in the style of a streetwear graphic lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The gothic cross and raglan sleeves are the defining graphics.
- Keep the white cars for a clean, sleek background.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the white cars for a clean background.
